research.text: I start a long task, go make tea, come back, and it's been stuck on one permission prompt the whole time.
My laptop slept overnight, and in the morning the session was just gone.
When five prompts are waiting, I just press yes on all of them. I know I shouldn't.
I run Claude Code and Cursor together, and I never know which one is waiting for me.

feedback.text: It's great for approving, but when I want to start something, I expect a chat, like Claude.
Adding a new task felt like filling in a form.
